ai.purpose: Simulation entry points for Standard Model excitation sectors, gauge geometry, Higgs stabilization, and high-energy resonance behavior.

simulation_hooks.name: excitation_resonance_topology_sim
simulation_hooks.description: Simulates excitation modes as resonance patterns across substrate fields.

simulation_hooks.name: gauge_geometry_sim
simulation_hooks.description: Models gauge symmetries as resonance surfaces shaping interaction channels.

simulation_hooks.name: higgs_stability_sim
simulation_hooks.description: Simulates mass generation and stability basins via Higgs coupling.

simulation_hooks.name: sector_transition_sim
simulation_hooks.description: Simulates transitions across excitation sectors (e.g., flavor mixing).

simulation_hooks.name: high_energy_symmetry_restoration_sim
simulation_hooks.description: Simulates electroweak symmetry restoration and sector merging at high energies.

simulation_hooks.name: regime_transition_sim
simulation_hooks.description: Simulates Standard Model behavior across R1 → R2 → R3 → R4 transitions.

notes: All simulations operate on resonance topology and gauge geometry, not particle metaphors. Outputs are substrate-aligned and regime-aware.
